## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm test` passes locally
- [ ] `pnpm check` run — no formatting drift
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`), or this change is invisible to consumers
- [ ] Tests follow [`TESTING.md`](../TESTING.md); new source files are covered (CI enforces 100%)
- [ ] The Skill (`packages/rforge/skill/`) and `docs/` are updated if this changes behaviour they describe
- [ ] I have accepted the [CLA](../CLA.md) (the bot will ask on your first pull request)
